outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic (breast anatomy diagram) plus a classification table; no averaged data plot is shown.
Panel B is a conceptual schematic outlining the study aim; no data plot is present.
Panel C is a schematic depicting the luciferase recording method; no data plot is present.
Panel D shows idealized example curves illustrating the analysis workflow (stationary/non-stationary quantification), not actual measured averaged data requiring individual points.
Panel E is an illustrative heatmap schematic depicting the correlation analysis concept, not real data; heatmaps are also exempt from this check regardless.
Panel F shows illustrative example growth curves for a schematic workflow, not averaged experimental data with replicates; line plots are also exempt from this check.
Panel G shows illustrative example dose-response curves depicting the workflow concept, not actual averaged data; line plots are exempt from this check.
Panel H is an illustrative schematic showing example heatmap and mutation grid icons representing the genomic analysis workflow, not real averaged data; heatmaps/tables are exempt.

Panel I shows illustrative example scatter plots (PCA cluster and 3D parameter space) depicting the concept of subtype definition; scatter plots inherently show individual points and are exempt from this check.
